note: Coverage manifest, not a fixed skill count. tests/test_skill_coverage.py discovers skills from the tree.

agent-jsonl-compact-reader.proves: The pinned 0.3.1 CLI contract on synthetic JSONL when the dedicated job installs it.
agent-jsonl-compact-reader.does_not_prove: No 0.2 legacy export run, no real session log, no default local run when the binary is absent.

check-finished-workdoc.proves: The bundled completion chapter template has the expected section and status shape.
check-finished-workdoc.does_not_prove: No live repository completion audit, no claim that a checked box is true.

demo-rehearsal.proves: Frontmatter, links and bundle shape are valid.
demo-rehearsal.does_not_prove: No timed rehearsal, screenshot capture, audience agent or PDCA run.

grill-me.proves: Frontmatter, links and the bundled question bank exist.
grill-me.does_not_prove: No interview round, no user confirmation and no research behavior.

handover.proves: The output template and final-check section are present and internally linkable.
handover.does_not_prove: No generated handover, no placeholder replacement and no privacy decision.

harness2-portable-workflow.proves: Frontmatter and bundle shape are valid.
harness2-portable-workflow.does_not_prove: No Harness2 baseline/candidate run, no receipt, no evaluation.

herdr-opencode-agmsg.proves: Pure provider-plan and cleanup decisions on synthetic catalogs and requests.
herdr-opencode-agmsg.does_not_prove: No live Herdr, OpenCode, provider, agmsg or credential behavior.

jax-performance-tuning.proves: No missing bundled trace script and no tool-specific absolute cache path remain.
jax-performance-tuning.does_not_prove: No JAX/GPU run, no cache hit, no profiler trace and no measured speedup.

mujoco-web-wasm-demo.proves: Frontmatter, links and bundle shape are valid.
mujoco-web-wasm-demo.does_not_prove: No browser, WebGL, MJCF loading or screenshot run.

playwright-cli-automation.proves: Frontmatter, links and bundle shape are valid.
playwright-cli-automation.does_not_prove: No browser automation, console capture or screenshot comparison.

public-repository-privacy-review.proves: The repository scan classifies synthetic canaries, never echoes values, and refuses non-Git roots and escaping symlinks instead of widening scope.
public-repository-privacy-review.does_not_prove: No human publication review and no guarantee that a zero hit is safe.

review-measurement-contract.proves: Frontmatter and bundle shape are valid.
review-measurement-contract.does_not_prove: No benchmark review, denominator recomputation or decision.

review-written-workdoc.proves: The bundled review rubric keeps its numbered section shape.
review-written-workdoc.does_not_prove: No workdoc review, no edit application and no verdict.

skill-creator.proves: Strict YAML, duplicate-key, non-mapping and name/description failures are real and tested.
skill-creator.does_not_prove: No agent loader registration and no authoring session.

start-with-workdocs.proves: The completion command is documented with its zero-count exit behavior.
start-with-workdocs.does_not_prove: No checklist execution and no work-record update.

start-work-audit-pattern.proves: Role files and the audit prompt template are present and runtime-neutral.
start-work-audit-pattern.does_not_prove: No coordinator/worker/auditor run and no audit acceptance.

start-work-with-docs.proves: Frontmatter and bundle shape are valid; no execution is claimed.
start-work-with-docs.does_not_prove: No sequential workdoc execution, no DoD artifact and no failed-step handling.

supervisor-orchestration.proves: The routing reference uses capability labels and a runtime mapping note.
supervisor-orchestration.does_not_prove: No subagent routing, no artifact verification and no integration.

write-evidence-based-adr.proves: Frontmatter and bundle shape are valid.
write-evidence-based-adr.does_not_prove: No ADR writing session and no evidence adjudication.

write-workdoc-docker.proves: The Docker workdoc template keeps its sections and four-line checklist shape.
write-workdoc-docker.does_not_prove: No Docker build or runtime check, and no generated workdoc.

write-workdoc-uv.proves: The uv workdoc template keeps its sections and four-line checklist shape.
